source.title: Rigidity and non local connectivity of Julia sets of some quadratic polynomials
source.author: Genadi Levin
source.theorem: Theorem 7: (Y0a) and (Y0b) give convergence; adding (Y1) gives Mandelbrot local connectivity at the limit.

conditions.Y1: there exists beta > 0 with limsup q_m / max(product(q_0,...,q_(m-1))^2, exp(beta product(q_0,...,q_(m-2)))) > 0

explicit_witness_family.interpretation: The finite witness moves the root expression toward 1 while satisfying the checked finite versions of the three growth patterns.

remaining_scope: unbounded satellite sequences failing (Y0a),(Y0b),(Y1) and other imported growth criteria
ledger_policy: Keep global MLC and virtual obligations open; this certificate closes only the Levin Theorem 7 branch.
